items.title: “The Single Best Replacement for Jensen”: Palo Alto CEO Nikesh Arora. There’s Only One Problem
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSequoia’s Shaun Maguire and 20VC’s Harry Stebbings have named Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora as their pick to replace Jensen Huang at Nvidia, which is searching for a new CEO. The louder the case for Arora gets, the more key-man risk Palo Alto carries, because its premium valuation depends on a deal-driven plan he is still carrying out.
